about: R as a cut-in cinematic and the ult form's ghost blades (lane U, 10-19). Dex 10-16 / 10-19: the call at its original speed; then during the flurry she disappears: she BECOMES the slashes that slash the letter into existence (hundreds of them, each carving a piece, ~3 s or more; the letter ABSOLUTELY HUGE, a nuke; it matches her R line 一筆――天を断つ: 断 or 天); the slashes stop a moment (a beat of stillness); then she dives straight down from above, a vertical blur, and destroys everything: a nuke (a white / orange / red first flash engulfed by her blue flames, a huge eruption); the dust clears on the ult form; control back after the nuke. The form stands still-ish on one frame and summons ghost blades; its chain moves her as the normal chain does (Dex: no teleports in the chain). Ticks at 60 a second, distances in H (96 world px; she is 0.88 H). feel.json's ult block keeps the gameplay numbers (impact radius / damage / knockback, the form's length, cooldown, damage multiplier, the ghost hit); its R timings (callTicks .. revealTicks, riseTicks, zoomOut) are superseded by this file. ult.ts reads it; ultdraw.ts draws the stand-ins (clearly temporary until the FX v2 loop's effects, lanes/fx/v2/built/, and lane A's r_* drawings land).

clips.about: Length of the call and the reveal when their drawing is not in yet (the white box plays the same timeline); with a drawing they last exactly their clip, played 1:1 (the call at its original speed). From lane A's picks (lanes/anim/moves/<slot>/make.py). r_flurry plays only up to the storm beat (she crouches, bursts into ash, gone); the rest of the flurry is the slashes.

beats.about: Moments inside the clips as [source frame of the H3 take, clip tick]: anim.json frames carry `src` (kit v1.4) and the beat lands on the first drawing at or past it; without src the clip tick scales with the clip's length.

letter.about: The letter she carves, synced to the FX v2 loop (lanes/fx/v2/PLAN.md, decided there: 天, 960 art px tall = 6.6 H; ~450 slashes over 3.2 s carving it roughly in stroke order, density building; then a closing sweep per stroke; then the slashes stop: a 0.5 s hold). Here: which character (天 or 断, from her R line 一筆――天を断つ; strokes in ult.ts LETTERS), its box (`size` H square, its bottom `low` H above the floor, its near edge `ahead` H in front of her), the storm (`slashes` cuts over `ticks`, each carving a piece of a stroke; a share `pieces` of them carve new pieces, the rest re-cut; the last `closing` are the sweeps, one per stroke `sweepGap` ticks apart), the brush's thickness (a share of the box), how far above the letter's top she hangs before the dive. Never mirrored: facing left it moves to her left, the strokes stay as written. A stand-in until the loop's r_flurry.

camera.about: The shots: world x at the frame's centre, world y on the anchor row (the anchor is that row's share of the frame's height). Zooms stay within the painted levels (2 = the close band) so the world stays crisp; the letter's pull-out goes down to 0.55 and the nuke's to 0.4 (the FX v2 loop's framing) (lane C 10-19: below 1 she and her effects reduce onto her own grid). The call: a cut-in close on her, pushing in to the BOOM, craning up with the fire, settling as she coils. The flurry: a hard cut wide onto the letter, pulling out as it is carved. The stop: dead still. The dive: a push down after her onto the crater. The impact: the pull-out on the nuke. The reveal: back in on her. Reduced motion: hard cuts between held levels (2 for the call, 1 for the rest), no moves.

cues.about: Sound cue ids for lane D (sound.ts maps an id to its files; an id with no file is silent), fired on these beats: press (the cut-in), line (her R call, normal register: 一筆――天を断つ), boom (the bass hit as the fire line ignites), fire (the curtain's roar), draw (the sword), vanish (she bursts into ash), slash (every 6th slash of the storm: a dense roll, not hundreds of files), last (the closing cut: a bass hit), hush (the stop: dead silence, everything ducks out until dive), dive (the dive's whoosh), impact (the nuke: the biggest bass hit), rumble (the eruption's long tail), reveal (the dust clears), lineUlt (her ult-register line on the reveal pose); the form: blade (a ghost blade summoned), cut (it strikes).

form.about: The ult form (Dex 10-19): a killing machine standing still-ish on one frame (uf_idle holds one drawing), summoning ghost blades; Dex after playing it: "the ult form doesn't need to TP her during the attack chain, just make the movement make sense": the chain moves her as the normal chain does (controller.ts: the uf drawings' planted foot, the lunges, m1_3's lock-on). Ghost blades per chain step (`blades`), summoned around her (behind and above her shoulders, `ring` H out) `summon` ticks before each hit and striking `ghostDelay` (feel.json) after it, through the nearest foe in `reach` H in front of her (its middle), else through the point `ahead` H in front of her where the swing lands; each takes `strike` ticks and fades over `fade`.

fx.about: The FX v2 loop's effects (lanes/fx/v2/PLAN.md ids, played through game.fx.play when the game has them; until then the stand-ins in ultdraw.ts draw): callFire (her blue fire carpet, from the BOOM until she vanishes, at her feet), letter (the flurry: the letter carved by the slashes and the hold, at the letter's foot, never mirrored), dive (her line through the letter), nuke (at the crater), clear (the smoke clearing off her ult form).
